records.title: Exact Quantile Balancing and Load-Error Injection for Mixture-of-Experts
records.reason: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training requires global load balance to prevent expert under-utilization and local balance for efficient expert-parallel execution. Existing distributed Quantile Balancing (QB) uses shard-dependent or approximate global quantiles, while token-independent expert biases cannot ensure microbatch-level balance. records.title: Scaling Attention Head Analysis via Gradient-Based Attribution in Context-Aware Machine Translation
records.reason: In this paper, we introduce a gradient-based head attribution strategy where the Token-level Max-Margin loss is backpropagated to the attention maps. This framework enables a large-scale causal analysis of attention heads, making it suitable for LLMs. We evaluate our method on the task of disambiguation in Context-aware Machine Translation, where we analyze 50 phenomena across 4 models and 4 language directions. records.title: GLASS: Architecture-Tuned, Composable, Device-Side Linear Algebra for Edge Robotics and Beyond
records.reason: GPU robotics lacks the reusable numerical infrastructure of mature CPU stacks, instead relying on compiler frameworks that introduce overhead or repeatedly reimplementing numerical libraries. To address this, we introduce GLASS (GPU Linear Algebra Simple Subroutines), a header-only CUDA C++ library that provides thread-, warp-, block-, and NVIDIA-backed implementations of robotics-scale linear algebra and geometric computations under one composable device API. records.title: MemBodied: Recurrent Associative Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
records.reason: Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for general-purpose robot control, yet a vast majority of policies do not preserve and leverage episode-level information beyond the current observation. This limitation is consequential in history-dependent manipulation tasks that depend on information available only in past observations.
